title: Financial caution inherited from her father; support for musicians
summary: Her cautious saving and what-if planning, learned from her father, helps her now; she says musicians need more support programs and grants.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Yeah. Do you think — I’m going to say your lifestyle, figuring out how to make a living in music sort of improvising along the way, has helped you figure out this next, this current situation?

You know I think what’s helped me is I have this kind of a cautious side to me, financially I’ve always been aware of my age and that I could become sick at any moment and wouldn’t be able to work. All you have to do is fall down once and you can’t drive to your lessons. And so I’ve always made sure to stick some money in the bank and not get caught, and try to make a mental list of what I could sell if I needed to, and that kind of thing. Also, because of global warming and knowing you can be hit by any kind of a storm of any kind you know, any kind of a pollution thing or a meltdown, there’s so much in this world that you know people tend to block out I guess but I listen and I try to learn and I think about that, all the what ifs. And so I have that side. And my father had it. I got it from him. He had it to an extreme. He always like worried and bit his nails and thought about — he put aside money for my college since I was like born or before that, and stuff like that. I don’t go as far as that but I mean I try not to worry about © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
I try to concretely keep track of that financially. So that’s what I think has helped me over the years, and now especially.

Well it’s nice to hear — you are fairly upbeat, and I hope other musicians can echo some of your sentiments. I know people who, some of my friends who depend totally on gigs and they have nothing. They’ve entered the unemployment realm and they seem to be doing okay. I’m sure they wish they hadn’t had to do that.

Absolutely. I mean yeah. People are definitely suffering. Musicians are suffering hardest, composers, actors, oh my God. I mean that’s yeah. There needs to be much more support programs and grants. There’s a good start but it’s not enough.
